effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If your opponent doesn't have a level 4 or lower Digimon in play, gain 2 memory.
[Your Turn] When one of your purple Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Tamer to ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card in your hand.
